name: KIC 6866149
description: A red-clump giant burning helium in its core in the Kepler field, 11.2 solar radii and 1.69 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 6866149 (Gold): Radius (Mosser scale, solar radii) 11.2103 +/- 0.1979

mass.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 6866149 (Gold): Mass (Mosser scale, solar masses) 1.6863 +/- 0.0653

temperature.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 6866149 (Gold): APOGEE effective temperature (K) 4825.508 +/- 49.3377

gravity.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 6866149 (Gold): Asteroseismic log g 2.5685 +/- 0.004

color.reason: The star lies in the Galactic plane hundreds to thousands of parsecs away, where interstellar dust reddens its spectra, and the colour routes do not remove it; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red-clump giant in the Kepler field, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations give 1.69 solar masses and 11.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,826 K at its surface.
